svg.text: • W1 (review.yml) skips when `review-bot-override` is present so W5's `bot-review` status is not overwritten.
• `merge-when-ready` is auto-stripped on push and on CI failure; the orchestrator restores it once CI passes again to keep the queue moving.
• Override labels (W5, W6, security-override) are auditable: every apply/remove posts a comment naming the maintainer who triggered it.
• See ci-checks-reference.md for per-check fix recipes and the full required-checks list.
